method: Isolated Django Client through middleware, cProfile enabled; READ ONLY transaction and rollback. Selected aggregate profiler rows, no response body or credentials persisted. Cumulative times overlap. Instrumented wall time is not an HTTP SLA.
conclusion: Most measured Django time remains inside projection. SQL transport, query compilation and Python all contribute; middleware wrapper cumulative time does not establish middleware overhead. Do not attribute all residual time to Sentry, TLS or cart.
